title: Step 3 - Understanding Flattening in Convolutional Neural Network Architecture

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome back to the course on Deep Learning.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎回到深度學習課程。

cues.en: I hope you're tracking along with these intuition tutorials just fine and that you had a chance to play around with everything we've learned so far.
cues.zh: 希望這些概念教學你都能順利跟上，也已經有機會動手試試目前學過的內容。

cues.en: And today we're talking about flattening.
And the good news is that this is a very simple step and this tutorial's going to be very quick and then we'll be able to move on to the next interesting things.
cues.zh: 好消息是，這個步驟很簡單，這堂課很快就能講完，然後繼續下一個有趣的內容。

cues.en: All right, so far, we've got the pooled layer pooled feature map, and that is after we apply the convolution operation to our image and then we apply pooling to the result
cues.zh: 目前有了池化層、池化後的特徵圖，也就是對影像做卷積，再對卷積結果

cues.en: of the convolution or to the convolved image.
cues.zh: 或卷積後的影像做池化所得到的。

cues.en: And so what are we going to do with this pooled feature map?
cues.zh: 接著要怎麼處理這張池化後的特徵圖？

cues.en: Well, we're going to take it and we're going to flatten it into a column.
cues.zh: 我們要把它攤平成一個直行。

cues.en: So basically just take the numbers row by row and put them into this one long column.
cues.zh: 基本上就是逐列取出數字，排進同一個長直行。

cues.en: And the reason for that is because we want to later input this into an artificial neural network for further processing.
cues.zh: 因為之後要把它輸入人工神經網路，進一步處理。

cues.en: So this is what it looks like when you have many pooling layers or you have the pooling layers with many pooled feature maps, and then you flatten them.
cues.zh: 如果有多個池化層，或池化層裡有多張池化後的特徵圖，把它們攤平就像這樣。

cues.en: So you put them into this one long column, sequentially one after the other, and you get one huge vector of inputs for an artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 依序一個接一個，放進同一個長直行，就得到人工神經網路的一個巨大輸入向量。

cues.en: And so to sum all of this up, we've got an input image.
cues.zh: 統整一下：先有輸入影像，

cues.en: We apply a convolution layer, and let's not forget the ReLU or rectified linear units function that we apply after the convolution layer as well.
cues.zh: 套用卷積層，也別忘記卷積層之後套用的 ReLU，也就是修正線性單元函數。

cues.en: And then we apply pooling, and then we flatten everything into a long vector, which will be our input layer
cues.zh: 再做池化，接著把所有內容攤平成長向量，作為
人工神經網路的輸入層。

cues.en: And exactly how that works, we'll find out in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 確切的運作方式，下一堂課就會介紹。

cues.en: Hope you enjoyed today's session and I look forward to you next time.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡今天的內容，期待下次與你見面。
在那之前，祝你享受深度學習的樂趣。
